game.title: Grand Theft Auto III – The Definitive Edition
game.notes: Mirror list (ruleset v2.1, Account-tracked achievements). The player confirmed on 2026-11-13 that their Rockstar Games Social Club account tracks this game's accomplishments for the Nintendo Switch version, so the Social Club page is the verification source for every entry, including counter-based ones the game itself does not display. Imported 1:1 at the player's request: the Social Club list has 44 entries (gta.wiki and gtabase agree on all names and descriptions; socialclub.rockstargames.com was not reached directly, so confidence is medium) - the 28 PS4/PS5 gameplay trophies, the Platinum counterpart 'King of Liberty City' (replaced by Pantheon's own Platinum, Rule 18) and 15 Social Club-only accomplishments (origin native-other, tiers assigned under Rule 5). Filter (Rules 10, 20, 21) was waived by the player's choice; Prune found no entry that needs content missing on Switch. IDs 001-017 and the Platinum (018) are unchanged from v1.0 so recorded progress survives; restored and new entries take 019-044 in import order (restored console entries first, then Social Club-only). The count exceeds Rule 4's 40-trophy reference because the mirror is 1:1. Mission-condition trophies stay flagged MISSABLE because mission replay is unconfirmed in the Definitive Edition. Known bug: leaving 'Kingdom Come' as the last 100% item has been reported to stop 100% registering - clear it early. Cheats are reported to block achievements on other platforms; assume a cheat-free save.

trophies.name: First Day on the Job
trophies.description: Complete 'Luigi's Girls'.
trophies.verification: 'Luigi's Girls' shows Mission Passed.

trophies.name: Disposing of the Evidence
trophies.description: Crush a car at the junkyard car crusher.
trophies.verification: The car is visibly lifted into the crusher and destroyed, paying out cash.

trophies.name: Wreckless Driving
trophies.description: Perform a Perfect Insane Stunt.
trophies.verification: The on-screen stunt bonus message names an Insane Stunt rated perfect and the bonus cash is paid; easiest off the larger stunt ramps.

trophies.name: Without a Scratch
trophies.description: On your first attempt at 'Mike Lips Last Lunch', take Mike Forelli's car to the bomb shop and back to where you found it without a scratch. A checkpoint reload or retry forfeits the first attempt. ⚠️ MISSABLE
trophies.verification: Mission Passed appears without failing or restarting the mission, with the car returned undamaged.

trophies.name: Planned Ahead
trophies.description: In "Farewell 'Chunky' Lee Chong", take out Chunky Lee Chong with a car rigged with a bomb. ⚠️ MISSABLE
trophies.verification: Chunky dies in the car-bomb explosion before Mission Passed.
